ALUMNI CONNECTIONS

Dear alumni and friends,

On behalf of the New York Institute of Technology Alumni Association, I am delighted to welcome the Class of 2026 as the newest members of our alumni community. This May, we also celebrated the silver and golden anniversaries of the Classes of 2001 and 1976, respectively. Congratulations to all on reaching these incredible milestones!

Graduation marks the beginning of an exciting new chapter, but you will always remain part of the New York Tech family. As alumni, you join a global network of more than 120,000 graduates who continue to support one another, give back to the university, and help shape the experiences of future students.

One of the most meaningful ways for alumni to stay connected is through volunteer involvement. Whether you are interested in mentoring students, speaking at career panels, assisting at alumni events, supporting admissions outreach, or helping with networking programs, there are many opportunities for you to make a difference. Your experience, insights, and enthusiasm can have a powerful impact on current students who are just beginning their journeys.

Getting involved is also a great way to stay connected with classmates, expand your professional network, and remain engaged with the university community. No matter where your career or life takes you, there is always a place for you within our New York Tech network.

We invite you to explore the many ways you can participate and give back. Your continued engagement helps strengthen our community and ensures that the next generation of students has the same opportunities that helped shape your own path.

Please complete this alumni engagement form to let us know your areas of interest.

As always, I welcome your suggestions and ideas for events and initiatives. Please feel free to contact me at jdoe@nyit.edu.

Have a wonderful summer!

Go Bears!

Sabrina Polidoro

Director, Alumni Relations and Special Events
